candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion and sign_in drops 27.1%; letting users create their pet first increases sign-in motivation.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in until after pet adoption was effective and slightly outperformed predictions (+13.3% measured vs +12.0% predicted).
Home page redesigns like interactive waiting rooms are helpful (+5.6% measured), though initial predictions were too high (+8.0% predicted).
Adoption incentives like photo quality guides and companion previews improved results (+7.6% measured), but were overestimated (+10.0% predicted).
